$comment: Curated release notes for the sidebar What's new popover and its release dialog. Newest first; each version must have a vX tag on the releases page.

entries.title: Steadier plugin navigation and toolbar text
entries.summary: Molecular files opened from Codex land in the plugin workspace, and the shared header reads as one toolbar.

sections.title: Plugin workspace
items: Compute tools and panels that are unavailable in the current host are hidden.
Unsaved sketches no longer offer file system actions.
Pages with the same name show which viewer they belong to.

sections.title: Annotations
items: Annotation mode resets when you switch documents or return to Recent files.
The Atoms and Residues picker sits above the annotation bar.

entries.title: Workspace home shows recent files and Ketcher
entries.summary: The start page drops prompts, demo cards and the search field and keeps what you return to most.

sections.title: Start page
items: Recent files and Ketcher are the only entries.
The expanded sidebar has one Ketcher route and highlights the active page.
Narrow layouts keep a labelled navigation menu.

entries.title: Home and open pages in expanded plugin workspaces
entries.summary: Expanded plugin workspaces no longer trap you inside a single viewer.

sections.title: Navigation
items: Home, Ketcher and every open page are one click away.
Returning Home keeps open structures and sketches.
Compact cards keep navigation in one toolbar menu, and viewer controls stay visible at 420 px.

entries.title: Open molecular files with Burette inside Codex
entries.summary: Clicking a structure file in a Codex thread now offers Burette instead of the plain text viewer.

sections.title: Supported files
items: PDB, PDBQT, mmCIF, SDF, MOL, SMILES, XYZ, KET, RXN and MolViewSpec files open as a full workspace.
CSV and TSV stay with the Codex table viewer.

entries.title: Desmond trajectories play without a proprietary runtime
entries.summary: CMS and DTR files are read natively, and playback survives scene rebuilds.

sections.title: Playback
items: Stop, seek and rebuild no longer strand playback.
Smoothing moves the solute only and keeps solvent and ions in place.
Toolbar popovers inside the viewer are back.

entries.title: xyzrender animation per card
entries.summary: Each card on an xyzrender sheet keeps its own style and animation.

sections.title: Animation
items: Editing or animating one card no longer re-renders the others.
Opening the animation dialog does not start a render by itself.
With several cards selected, Apply to N selected animates them together.

sections.title: Dock
items: Tabs in a narrow right dock no longer shrink or slide when clicked.

entries.title: Native Mol* right-click menu on macOS
entries.summary: Right-clicking a structure opens a macOS menu instead of the web panel.

sections.title: Menu
items: Representation and colour settings are a native submenu with sliders and swatches.
Every change made while the menu is open is one undo step.

entries.title: Move files to Trash without a confirmation
entries.summary: Move to Trash acts immediately, like Finder.

sections.title: Files
items: A dialog appears only when the move fails and offers a retry.
A successful move plays the Finder trash sound when interface sounds are on.
